wiki.title: Doug Wozniak
wiki.extract: Douglas Chester Wozniak (born January 17, 1947) is an American politician serving as a member of the Michigan House of Representatives since 2023, currently representing the 59th district. A member of the Republican Party, he previously represented the 36th district from 2019 to 2021, and served in the Michigan Senate from 2021 to 2023.
